name: `ekoko
desc: `ekoko (Euphorbia celastroides): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Euphorbia celastroides is a flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is referred to by the common name 'akoko by Hawaiians, and is a species of spurge closely related to the poinsettia.
